annotations.title: Share an email-reading rule (hack) with other people

description: Shares one of the person's hacks with everyone, or shares it again after a fix so everyone using a copy can take it. Give 1 to 5 example messages it reads, with every value made up: never the person's own messages. TrackerHacker refuses examples holding anything from the person's sheets or mail, addresses other than the sender's or example.com, and templates with a name or account number as fixed text. Works only if the person turned on "Let my assistant share what it builds" in Settings; otherwise tell them where it is.

examples.description: 1 to 5 made-up messages it reads, written like the real ones with other values.

name.description: The name everyone sees, like "Chase card alert"; the hack's own name if left out.
